integrity: The 1979 bibliographic record was checked for the exact public date. A complete 2013 same-object mathematical PDF was inspected through its model definition, kinetic equilibrium, and Hopf analysis, with full-document searches for moment, average, invariant-measure, and covariance terminology. A complete open 2014 same-object article was inspected for its exact model, linear transient analysis, and discussion of the summed equations, with targeted searches for moment, covariance, and average formulations. A 2016 Schnakenberg limit-cycle application was checked for primary MSC ownership and statement-level implication. The three conditional flux laws, total-concentration orthogonality, covariance identities, equality case, and periodic crossing theorem were independently reconstructed, and the algebra was replayed with the packaged checker.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is conditional on compact invariant probability measures in the nonnegative quadrant and does not establish existence of a nonconstant limit cycle for arbitrary parameters.
The fiber laws determine conditional means, not complete conditional distributions.
The second-order identities do not determine the variance of total concentration.
An equivalent short invariant-measure calculation could remain in unindexed chemical-oscillator literature.
title: Fiberwise flux calibration and exact anticorrelation in the Schnakenberg oscillator
